title: We tested 100 AI-generated component usages. Here is what the validator caught.
description: A reproducible 100-case benchmark: 30 valid usages and 70 defects across seven classes, with 65.7% structural recall, 100% precision, and zero false positives on valid cases.

title: Give Claude Code a component contract, not a component gallery
description: Why machine-readable manifests matter more than another set of React components, and what a coding agent actually needs before it can generate correct UI.

title: Seven ways AI-generated UI breaks, with real before/after cases
description: Walkthrough of seven real defect classes from the 100-case benchmark: hallucinated props, missing required props, invalid enums, orphaned compound parts, and the accessibility and state classes the validator still misses.

title: We built a production app on Slipstream UI. Here is what broke.
description: A real case study from dancepath.net: seven concrete gaps a dense interactive app surfaced in the library, what worked (tokens, subpath exports, axe-clean components), and which fixes are upstreamable.
